item.title: Changtai Banyue Mountain Hot Spring — 1 Adult + 1 Child Ticket from ¥189 (≈$27), Any Day
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child hot-spring ticket — ¥189 (≈$27) (was ¥399, 48% off) · Bookable Jun 23 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Hidden in a forested valley in Changtai （长泰半月山温泉）, about an hour’s drive from Xiamen, Banyue Mountain is a strontium-rich soda spring （富锶苏打汤泉） done in wild-luxury style — soaking pools tucked into mountain woodland rather than concrete blocks. One ticket covers 1 adult plus 1 child, usable weekdays and weekends (open 13:00–23:00).

item.title: Guangzhou Westin Pazhou — 2 Adults + 1 Child Lunch ¥299 (≈$42), 2 Adults + 2 Kids Dinner ¥499 (≈$70)
item.description:
Deal price: lunch 2 adults + 1 child — ¥299 (≈$42) · dinner 2 adults + 2 kids — ¥499 (≈$70) · was ¥1,298 · Bookable May 9 – Oct 14, 2026, any day · ⚠️ sale ends soon — valid through Oct 14, 2026

The Westin Pazhou （广交会威斯汀酒店， 1F, 681 Fengpu Middle Road, Haizhu, inside the Canton Fair Complex Area C) serves 100+ dishes at its Canton Bazaar buffet — at up to 76% off the ¥1,298 list price. Directly on the metro line with 3 hours of free parking, so lunch blends easily into a day of sightseeing. Dinner runs 17:30–21:30.

item.title: Jiaxing Kaiyuan Senbo Resort — 1-Night Terrace Room from ¥818 (≈$115) with Water Park & Kids' Club
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night Terrace Room — from ¥818 (≈$115) (was ¥1,398, 59% off) · Bookable Aug 21 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

Kaiyuan Senbo Resort （开元森泊度假乐园， 1677 Ganpu Avenue, Haiyan, Jiaxing) is a national Top-100 family resort hotel built around water and play: a 31,000㎡ indoor-outdoor water park (the indoor part open year-round) plus Fantasy Island （幻想岛）, a 2,300㎡ indoor children’s playground. Every package includes breakfast for 2 at the Cave Restaurant （岩洞餐厅）, 2 park tickets of your choice (two parks to choose from), a handicraft workshop (pick 1 of 3), a 屹奇 travel photo shoot, welcome fruit, and day-1 minibar drinks.

item.title: Taihu Longemont Resort — 1-Night Stay from ¥629 (≈$89) at Your Choice of 3 Themed Hotels + 2 Park Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 park tickets — from ¥629 (≈$89) (was ¥1,298, 49% off) · Bookable Sep 14 – Dec 31, 2026, any day · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

One of China’s largest family resorts, Taihu Longemont （太湖龙之梦， Taihu resort area, Changxing, Huzhou) lets you choose your hotel — 动物世界大酒店 (Animal World Hotel), 钻石酒店 (Diamond Hotel), or 古镇大酒店 (Ancient Town Hotel) — and pick 2 park tickets from three options: the Animal World walk-through zone, the Ice & Snow Town, or the Performance City （演艺城）. A national Top-100 family resort hotel.

item.title: Xiamen InterContinental Seaview Hotel — Weekend 1 Adult + 1 Child Buffet from ¥158 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m) — lunch ¥158 (≈$22) / dinner ¥198 (≈$28) (was ¥262, 61% off) · Bookable Sep 2 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A Huandao Road landmark, the InterContinental Xiamen （厦门海景洲际酒店） is running a new seafood-season menu （开海季） across its 9 food stations and 100+ dishes. The deal covers 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m) with free access to the kids’ playground, and 3 hours of free parking. Lunch runs 11:30–14:00; dinner 17:30–21:30.

item.title: Anji Hello Kitty Castle Hotel — 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Theme Park Entry, from ¥699 (≈$98)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 Hello Kitty Park adult tickets with 2-day unlimited entry — ¥699 (≈$98) (was ¥1,098) · Currently bookable and reservable (the merchant page shows no end date — book while it’s live)

The Anji Yinjun Jinjiang Castle Hotel （安吉银润锦江城堡酒店， 8 Tiandao, Anji, Huzhou) is every kid’s fantasy base camp: a literal castle with a covered walkway straight into Hello Kitty Park, and the headline package includes adult tickets with unlimited re-entry across 2 days — arrive Friday afternoon, play Friday and Saturday, and never queue twice.

item.title: Guangzhou Latin Restaurant — Brazilian BBQ Buffet from ¥106 (≈$15), Weekdays
item.description:
Deal price: weekday all-you-can-eat Brazilian BBQ — from ¥106 (≈$15)/person (was ¥138) · Bookable Sep 10 – Oct 31, 2026, weekdays only · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A Guangzhou institution for over a decade: the Latin Restaurant （拉丁餐厅） at Grandview Plaza （正佳广场， 4F, 228 Tianhe Road, near the Sports Center) serves an immersive Brazilian-style churrasco — 30+ kinds of grilled meats carved right at your table, plus 100+ buffet items, samba dancers, and guests are even invited on stage during the show. Kids get pasta and a chocolate fountain of their own.

item.title: Qiyun Mountain Resort Hotel — 2 Nights + Scenic Tickets, Bamboo Raft & Night Show, from ¥839 (≈$118)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + 2-person scenic combo for ¥839 (≈$118) (was ¥1,199) · Bookable Sep 16 – Dec 31, 2026, no weekend surcharge · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Qiyun Mountain （齐云山， Xiuning County, Huangshan) is in peak autumn sea-of-clouds season, and the resort hotel is running its “shaiqiu” (晒秋） harvest-season promo: no surcharge on weekends, plus a free room upgrade on non-holiday stays (mention it when booking).

item.title: Yangzhou Slender West Lake Huijing Hotel — 2 Nights + 3 Buffet Meals a Day, from ¥579 (≈$82)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + daily buffet breakfast, lunch & dinner for two — ¥579 (≈$82) (was ¥399/night) · Bookable Oct 10 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

This is the “livestream special” we’ve been waiting for in Yangzhou: the Slender West Lake Huijing Hotel （瘦西湖汇璟酒店） sits at the foot of Daming Temple right next to the 5A-rated Slender West Lake scenic area. Two nights in an elegant comfort room (28㎡, king or twin) with three buffet meals a day — breakfast, lunch and dinner — plus a free ride between the hotel and Yangzhou / Yangzhou East train station or the scenic area itself.

item.title: Zhangzhou Jiulongshuizhen — Ancient Hot-Spring Wellness Grand Opening, from ¥89 (≈$13)
item.description:
Deal price: kid’s hot-spring ticket + hot-spring egg + perilla drink — ¥89 (≈$13) (was ¥199, 4.5折） · Bookable Sep 24 – Dec 30, 2026, weekdays · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026

A brand-new hot-spring opening near Xiamen: the Jiulongshuizhen Resort’s Ancient Hot-Spring Wellness Center （漳州九龙水镇度假区， 666 Taikouzhai, Hua’an County — about 40 minutes from Xiamen North station) leans into Song-dynasty aesthetics — ancient-style pools, fish therapy, herbal foot soaks, costume dress-up for photos, and a “Song-style Fujian meal” （宋风闽味） on the higher tiers.

item.title: Hyatt Regency Xiamen Wuyuan Bay Weekday Buffet — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Lunch ¥168 (≈$24)
item.description:
Deal price: weekday lunch, 1 adult + 1 kid under 6 — ¥168 (≈$24) (was ¥228, ~26% off) · Bookable Jan 21 – Dec 31, 2026, weekdays only · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

The Hyatt Regency at Wuyuan Bay (湖里区钟宅西三路与枋湖路交叉路口, near Wanyuecheng business district) keeps its weekday lunch buffet at a fixed ¥168 for 1 adult + 1 child under 6 — over 1,000 vouchers sold, so this one is well battle-tested. Expect seafood hot dishes, teppan grills, fresh sashimi and 100+ dishes, plus juices, tea, coffee and a full salad bar.

item.title: Xiamen 'Southeast Asia Food Festival' Weekend Buffet, from ¥108 (≈$15) — Free Hairy Crab
item.description:
Deal price: single buffet lunch ¥108 (≈$15), dinner ¥118 (≈$17) (was ¥198, 5.5折) · Bookable Oct 9 – Dec 31, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

The “bringing the flavors of Southeast Asia to Xiamen’s table” festival buffet (湖里区长浩路18号) leans into tropical comfort food — think satay grills, laksa and coconut desserts — and every dining adult is handed one free hairy crab during the festival. That’s a crab bonus on top of a buffet that already runs at about half price.

item.title: Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel — 1 Night + 2-Day Park Tickets for 2, from ¥999 (≈$141)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2-day unlimited park tickets for 2 — from ¥999 (≈$141) (was ¥1,399, ~29% off) · Bookable Sep 16 – Oct 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A turnkey theme-park weekend for two: the Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel (同安区石浔南路1111号), a newly opened family hotel ranked among Fujian’s top 20 family resorts, bundles a 1-night stay with breakfast and unlimited 2-day entry for 2 to Dream Kingdom (梦幻王国) or Oriental Heritage (东方神画) — Xiamen’s answer to the Disney two-day playbook, minus the flight.

item.title: Xiamen Thai Food Festival Buffet at Garden Hotel — 1 Adult + 1 Kid Lunch ¥118 (≈$17)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid under 1.3 m lunch — ¥118 (≈$17) (was ¥298, 2.7折) · Bookable Jul 22 – Oct 31, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

This is the deepest discount in today’s batch. An established garden-style hotel on 虎园路 in central Xiamen is running a Thai food-festival theme buffet — seafood, snacks, and teppan-grilled skewers coming off the iron in rotation — and the headline price works out to under 40% of the original ¥298. Kids between 1.3 m and 1.4 m have their own ¥78 tier. Over 600 vouchers have been sold.

item.title: Xiamen Weekend Buffet — Coca-Cola Pop-Up Edition, 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥158 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid under 1.4 m, lunch or dinner — ¥158 (≈$22) (was ¥298, 5.4折) · Bookable Aug 29 – Oct 31, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A fun one for families: this Xiamen weekend buffet (湖里区南山冠军路6-13号) has teamed up with Coca-Cola for a pop-up edition — Coca-Cola–themed dishes, kiln-roasted pizza from a live oven, and unlimited limited-edition Coca-Cola mocktails. Dinner unlocks the bigger guns: crayfish and herb-grilled lamb chops from the teppan station.

item.title: Wuyuan Mingyu Hotel — 1 Night by a 4A Scenic Area + Breakfast from ¥299 (≈$42)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a Huizhou-style courtyard hotel + breakfast, from ¥299 (≈$42) (was ¥699, about 43% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026, weekends included · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A first for this site: Jiangxi’s Wuyuan — the “most beautiful countryside in China” county, famous for its rapeseed fields and white-walled Huizhou villages. Mingyu Hotel sits right inside the Wangkou 4A scenic area, wrapped by two rivers, built as a Huizhou-style courtyard with the classic “thousand-gold gatehouse, four-tael house” (千金门楼、四两屋) layout. The hotel even has its own Hui-carving art museum by master Yu Youhong, with an interactive experience zone and evening guided tours (8:00 pm).

item.title: Xiamen Haiyue Shanzhuang — 1 Night + Go-Karting + Kids' Park from ¥799 (≈$113)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + go-karting + kids’ park — from ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥1,488, about 54% of list) · Bookable through Oct 25, 2026, no weekday/weekend surcharge · ⏰ valid through Oct 25, 2026

A national Top-100 family resort sitting on Xiamen’s Golden Coast (思明区环岛南路3999号) — the property is separated from the beach only by the marathon track, and an underpass leads straight to Huangcuo beach for sand play. Inside: 1,000,000㎡ of gardens with 20,000+ trees and 400+ rare plant species, 19 pools (outdoor pools open May–Oct), an ~800㎡ Little Dolphin kids’ park (ball pit, trampolines, wave slide), and 622 rooms.

item.title: Xiamen Monster Power Sports Park — Indoor Play: Trampolines + Climbing Tower, 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥89 (≈$13)
item.description:
Deal price: one ticket, four zones, all-day play — from ¥59 (≈$8) (was ¥188, about 32% of list) · Bookable through Oct 15, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Oct 15, 2026

When the autumn rain hits Xiamen, this is the kind of place you’ll be grateful for: a 4,000㎡ indoor sports playground over two floors, right at Huli Park metro (Line 4 exit). One ticket gets you into all four zones with 40+ activities — a full-category trampoline arena, the Monster Cube climbing tower, the Monster Grid zone, plus a crawling-pet and cute-pet house — with no time limit on the day ticket.

item.title: Xiamen W Hotel — 'Nine Li Fishing Feast' Buffet, from ¥188 (≈$26)
item.description:
Deal price: buffet lunch from ¥188 (≈$26), dinner from ¥208 (≈$29) (was ¥268, ~30% off) · Bookable Sep 1 – Oct 31, 2026, weekends included · ⏰ valid through Oct 31, 2026

A proper five-star-hotel seafood splurge at a fraction of the usual price. W Xiamen’s NINE restaurant (思明区吕岭路1599号, 5th floor) is running a “Nine Li Fishing Feast” (九里开渔宴) theme buffet — the lunchtime spicy-seafood stalls alone are worth the trip: clams, cockles, mud snails, cone snails and mango clams sizzling to order, plus garlic-grilled oysters, spicy shrimp and a rich shrimp broth. Dinner steps it up with a cheese-baked baby lobster on the house and a live-made over-the-bridge giant grouper (过桥大龙趸) carved in front of you.

item.title: Guangzhou Science City Poly Junya — 1 Night + 2 Buffets for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, ¥518 (≈$73)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 buffets, 2 adults + 2 kids — from ¥518 (≈$73) (was ¥1,299, about 40% of list) · Bookable Oct–Dec 2026, weekends included · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Tucked next to the Baiyun ecological reserve in Guangzhou Science City — metro-reachable — Poly Junya runs one of the strongest-value family bundles we’ve seen: a 1-night superior room for 2 adults + 2 kids (under 1.2 m) with two buffet meals (worth over ¥700 on their own), plus a heated indoor pool, kids’ playground and gym. A taller kid (1.4 m) can be included on the ¥588 tier.

item.title: Hangzhou Tianmu Dusit Thani — 50㎡ Garden-View Room + Private Hot-Spring Soak, ¥599 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast + private hot-spring soak — from ¥599 (≈$84) (was ¥1,999, 30% of list) · Bookable daily Oct–Dec 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

An autumn hot-spring escape in the bamboo forests of Tianmu Mountain, about 60 minutes from downtown Hangzhou. Dusit Thani’s Thai-hospitality property pairs a spacious 50㎡ garden-view twin room with balcony and daily breakfast for two with a 30-minute private outdoor wellness hot-spring soak — autumn in the mountains, steaming water, nobody queuing behind you.

item.title: Shanghai Lingang Ice-Snow Mingcheng Hotel — 1 Night + 2 All-Day Snow-Play Tickets, ¥799 (≈$113)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast + 2 all-day snow-play tickets — from ¥799 (≈$113) (was ¥1,598, 50% of list) · Bookable Oct–Dec 2026, weekends/holidays usable with ¥100 surcharge · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Real snow in Shanghai: this Lingang bundle pairs a 1-night superior room with daily breakfast at the Ice-Snow Mingcheng Hotel with 2 all-day unlimited snow-play tickets at the Yaoxue Snow World next door — the tickets are valid across 2 days, so you get two full snow days — plus complimentary hot-spring tickets thrown in. Guests note the tickets alone nearly pay for the room.

item.title: Xiamen Jimei Guole Park — 14-Ride Family Ticket for 2 Adults + 2 Kids, ¥149 (≈$21)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 adults + 2 kids 14-item ticket — ¥149 (≈$21) (was ¥168; single gate ticket from ¥39.9 / ≈$5.60) · Buy-and-use, no reservation needed · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

A 40,000㎡ outdoor treasure for young kids in Xiamen’s Jimei district: Guole Park bundles gate entry + 11 rides + 3 animal-feeding experiences into one 14-item ticket. Petting zones, classic carnival rides, and wide-open running space — the whole family’s afternoon sorted. Buy-and-use with no reservation, refundable any time, and auto-refund if it expires.

item.title: Xiamen Lingling Hotel — 1 Night + 2 Circus Tickets + Animal Kingdom Access, ¥599 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfasts + 2 circus tickets + Animal Kingdom — from ¥599 (≈$84) (was ¥1,930, about 31% of list) · Bookable Oct–Dec 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

The full Xiamen show-and-zoo weekend in one ticket: 1 night (deluxe twin or king) at Lingling Hotel with 2 breakfasts, 2 standard seats to the Lingling circus (any session you like), and unlimited Animal Kingdom sightseeing for the whole stay — pandas, parrots, the lot. The package refunds automatically if it expires and is refundable any time before you reserve.

item.title: Beijing Minmetals Narada (Xishan) — 6th Anniversary Family Package from ¥799 (≈$111)
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥799 (≈$111) (was ¥1,688 — over 50% off) · Anniversary gift pack included · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Beijing Minmetals Narada is celebrating its 6th anniversary with a family-loaded package: 1 night in a Junlan Xishan room with breakfast for two, plus a gift pack of 2 single-session Super Wings (超级飞侠) Land tickets, 2 kids’ buffet dinner tickets and an extra-bed coupon. (Note: this is the Xishan property, not the Fangshan Narada hot spring resort also on this site.)

item.title: Guangzhou Aoyuan Sheraton — Korean-Themed Buffet Dinner, 2 Adults + 2 Kids ¥368 (≈$51)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 adults + 2 kids ¥368 (≈$51) (comparable value ¥664 — save ¥216) · 1 adult + 1 kid ¥188 (≈$26) · 5-person ¥888 (≈$123) · kids’ dinner from ¥78 (≈$11) · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026 (not valid Dec 24)

Sheraton Guangzhou Panyu just launched a “Korean flavor” themed buffet dinner: Korean BBQ, crispy Korean fried chicken, Korean tempura, Norwegian salmon, fresh seafood — plus free-flow red and white wine. The 2-adults-2-kids combo is the headline: ¥368 against a ¥664 walk-in value. It’s right by the metro, so getting there is easy.

item.title: Hangzhou Yuan Exploration Hall — 1 Adult + 1 Kid 2-Visit Card ¥399 (≈$55)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid 2-visit card ¥399 (≈$55) (was ¥776 — 48% off) · Hangzhou-resident monthly card ¥399 · ⏰ purchase & activate by Nov 30, 2026; card valid 3 months after activation

An 8,000㎡ indoor high-tech discovery space built for rainy-day parenting: Yuan Exploration Hall mixes exhibits with hands-on engineering play. The headliner is a real car, disassembled to show every part, plus a station where kids assemble their own cars from blocks and test them on three different slides. The 3rd floor has a family rest cabin — a detail parents appreciate.

item.title: Shanghai Luan Garden Hotel — 2 Nights from ¥548 (≈$76), Free Disney Shuttle
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights from ¥548 (≈$76) (was ¥699) · 1 night ¥279 (≈$39) · ¥20 off orders over ¥299, ¥50 off over ¥598 · ⏰ bookable all year through Dec 31, 2026

A smart base for a Shanghai Disney trip: Luan Garden Hotel runs a free shuttle to Shanghai Disney Resort, includes daily breakfast for two, and throws in free parking. The standout offer is the 2-night package — stack the platform’s ¥50-off coupon and it lands at ¥548 for two nights (after coupon).

item.title: Xiamen Yuzhou Wyndham — Buffet + Adventure Island Play, 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥198 (≈$28)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid buffet + Adventure Island ¥198 (≈$28) (was ¥298) · Weekend dinner + park ¥268 (≈$37) · 5-visit cards ¥898/¥1,198 · ⏰ valid Wed/Thu/Sat/Sun through Dec 31, 2026

Freshly revamped: Yuzhou Wyndham Xiamen pairs its buffet with the on-site Adventure Island play zone — one ticket covers weekday dinner or weekend lunch for 1 adult + 1 kid (under 1.2 m) plus a full play session. The spread runs to 30+ live-steamed seafood dishes, with garlic baby lobster on weekend dinners and Inner Mongolia lamb as a signature roast.

item.title: Guangzhou DoubleTree Zengcheng — Seafood Dinner + Infinity Pool from ¥499 (≈$69)
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$69) for 1 night + breakfast + Huanlewan park ticket · + breakfast + seafood dinner ¥698 (≈$97) · Breakfast only, 2 nights ¥698 · + breakfast + brunch ¥499 · + breakfast + fruit picking + movie ticket ¥499 · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

At 61% off the ¥1,288 rack rate, the DoubleTree by Hilton Guangzhou Zengcheng (at Zengcheng Wanda Plaza) is the resort-style base camp for the district’s attractions. The dinner package comes with the hotel’s Southeast Asia-themed seafood dinner buffet, plus a 168 m² outdoor infinity pool that photographs beautifully at sunset, a 24-hour gym, and 232 rooms with Crabtree & Evelyn bath products, 55-inch TVs and smart toilets. Huanlewan amusement park is ~14 minutes by car; Baishuizhai and Junming Happy World are about half an hour away.
